title: TV-Rec: Time-Variant Convolutional Filter for Sequential Recommendation

layout.note: Two panels side by side on the same 5-column grid: staggered rows of filter boxes on top, the signal row x0 x1 x2 0 0 in the middle, the output row y0 y1 y2 shifted right at the bottom; panel title under each panel.

lesson: To show how a new operator differs from a standard one, draw the same computation twice on an identical grid and change only the colour coding (one colour for a shared parameter set versus one colour per position), letting arrows and outputs inherit those colours.
